data.title: Underground Mine and Shaft Works
data.summary: A working hard-rock mine: headframe and shaft, modular lined drifts, narrow gauge haulage, face equipment, ventilation and services.
data.description: Original CC0 underground mine construction set. Drift modules are thick walled interior shells on a 4 m grid with a 3.2 m by 3.0 m arched clear section and explicit drift ports, so a player can stand inside them. Narrow gauge track runs at 750 mm with rail ports, and ventilation duct carries its own ports. Articulated face equipment has named boom, bucket and wheel pivots, each with a rigid clip on that pivot: wheels and sheaves turn, doors and gates open and close, and booms, buckets, cart bodies and the tipple cradle tilt. Node transforms only, no skinning. Engineered, lined and lit workings; not a natural cave and not an open pit.
